## Review

The supplied C12-base patch confines operational changes to documentation; watchdog agrees on the five tracked files. Hashes, protected-byte equality, staged-empty state and runtime freshness remain parent attestations, not reviewer recomputation.
- Correct (Q1/Q5): Traced actual consumer `src/schemas/example.ts:5–29` and `example.test.ts:5–59`: external unknown data is strictly parsed to value/null; both parser paths reject invalid inputs; the test caller stops before array effects and preserves rejected input. Roles explicitly do not establish authorization. Actual configs/guard/manifest/Make/hooks compose coherently without claiming deployed ESM, HTTP or persistence behavior.
- Correct (Q2–Q4): `docs/consumer-cold-start.md:5–26` provides a bounded copy/merge route, not another installer/framework. Consumer AGENTS, Make target, script, manifest identity/private flag and local LICENSE are preserved; source MPL license is separate. Maintainer identities, workflow/harness/private-policy payloads are excluded. Manual bindings distinguish exact copies from customized shared files; proposal/preservation evidence leaves the consumer ref and inputs unchanged. Genuine mixed-ref examples do not manufacture prior adoption history.
- Correct (Q6): Reviewed the 34 captured command outcomes, actual diagnostic streams, helper controls/restores, generated-lock/audit/frozen-install evidence and clean hooked commit. TS2322/2, noExplicitAny/1, assertion/1 and unimported coverage/1 are intended failures, not missing-tool substitutes. Initial missing Gitleaks remains FileNotFoundError/null/false. Post-freeze scanner facts demonstrate their bounded clean/negative controls, not complete security. Final document audit checks 18 maintained docs/94 local links/seven overlay routes; report recommendation keeps C13 closure, hosted/legal/approval/publication authority separate.
- Finding: P1 — C13 summaries overstate the clean boundary suite as 16 tests/cases. Locations: `HANDOFF.md:17`, `docs/planning/c13-checks-disposition.md:15`, `docs/planning/rebuild-morning-report-2026-10-09.md:21`. Actual consumer `src/schemas/example.test.ts:5–59` defines 12 parameterized invalid cases plus three other tests, totaling 15; exact decoded clean output `/home/chris/scratch/coding-standards-c13-review-readable/18-stdout.txt:27` reports `15 passed (15)`. The only 16-test run adds the deliberately failing assertion (`23-stdout.txt:27`), reporting one failed plus 15 passed. This contradicts Q6's honest candidate-bound evidence requirement. Smallest fix: report 15 clean boundary tests in current C13 summaries; preserve original runtime records/helper print as historical observations and explicitly correct its inaccurate count rather than rewriting evidence. Verify the corrected summaries against clean/restored captured outputs, then parent refreshes affected bindings/freeze. No runtime source change or new product test is needed for this reporting correction.
- Fixed: None; read-only review.
- Merge verdict: BLOCK C13 evidence/source acceptance pending this narrow reporting correction. No additional current issue found in the selected integration seams. This is not push/main-merge/deploy authority.
